set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Default builds do not require -march=native or -ffast-math.
- Aggressive flags are opt-in with numerical caveats.
- Windows configuration exists and is hosted-tested.
- OpenMP is optional with equivalent serial fallback.
- CRAN-like and debug/sanitizer builds succeed.
- Accuracy and speed deltas between profiles are recorded.
set.title: Make compilation conservative, portable, and reproducible by default
